steps.text: Three months ago...

steps.name: Surprised Farmer
steps.text: What? The broken line is the man line, not the earth line? So it's an addled brain I'll need to worry about? Not some illness?

steps.name: Happy Farmer
steps.text: Ha, told you that walnut tree was planted for you. Go give it some fertilizer before it's too late!

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: I wouldn't say that. The broken line just means you'll face a difficult decision around the age of twenty.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: But who gets to walk a path without a few twists and turns? Just let it be. The line runs much smoother after that, doesn't it?

steps.name: Surprised Farmer
steps.text: That's right on the mark!

steps.name: Surprised Farmer
steps.text: My family farm was ruined by Catastrophe when I was twenty-three. I didn't know how I could make a living in the city.

steps.name: Surprised Farmer
steps.text: But I've done well enough for myself, coming with the rest of the folk to Dahuang to study agriculture and keeping in my old occupation.

steps.name: Happy Farmer
steps.text: Wow...

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: No one can predict fate. It's only a justification for what happened.

steps.name: Surprised Farmer
steps.text: I've heard about the wonders of the Tianshis, but I didn't expect you to know so much...

steps.name: Surprised Farmer
steps.text: A young girl like you is already a Shouye Tianshi at your age, Shu?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: We all gain wisdom at our own pace. I simply pass on the knowledge that I learned sooner than others.

steps.name: Happy Farmer
steps.text: Remarkable, remarkable. Say...

steps.name: Happy Farmer
steps.text: That young man over there has been staring at you for a while... do you know him?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Ah...

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: A guest. Sorry, we'll talk another time.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Zuo Le, Candleholder of the Sui Regulator, here to review the development of Dahuang and matters relating to the Sui.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: There are no restrictions on your daily activities, but I ask that you refrain from leaving Dahuang for the time being.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Your cooperation is much appreciated, Madam Shu.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Ah, so you're the new Candleholder I've heard so much about.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: This is just a customary review. It will not get in the way of your agricultural research. Feel free to go about your business as usual—

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: You're young. Do you even count as an adult yet?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: This place is pretty far out in the middle of nowhere. Did your journey go well? Any trouble with bandits?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: A few bandits are no trouble for me.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Regarding work on the Twelve Pagodas and Five Cities, the Sui Regulator hopes that you will cooperate with the Ministry of Works to advance the project smoothly, and that you will maintain a cordial relationship with the Tianshi Bureaus.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: In addition, there are some matters that require...

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Oh, you can walk through the fields if you want, as long as you don't step on the crops, but you should give the Tianshis a heads up if you want to visit the factory.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I understand the scope of my work, Madam Shu. I still have...

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: That's the house the last Candleholder used. It's been refurnished and ready for use.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: That's all. Any questions?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Er... no.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Good. I have a lot to do in the fields, so I'll take my leave.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Just ask around if you need any help. People here are very friendly to visitors.

steps.name: Mischievous Girl
steps.text: Wei!

steps.name: Mischievous Girl
steps.text: Wei!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Excuse me, I'm on official business—

steps.name: Mischievous Girl
steps.text: Here.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What's this? A lunchbox?

steps.name: Mischievous Girl
steps.text: You're hungry, aren't you?

steps.name: Mischievous Girl
steps.text: You've been standing there all day like a scarecrow. Do you even know how to get food on your own?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Oh... er, duoxie.

steps.name: Mischievous Girl
steps.text: You like it?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Yes, it's very good...

steps.name: Mischievous Girl
steps.text: You're just gonna eat without doing any work?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: *cough* *cough*...!

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Mind your manners, Grain Buds. This gentleman is a guest.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: But you said everyone in Dahuang needs to sweat in the fields before they eat.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: This strange boy says he's on official business, but he's not working the fields or building houses. What's he here for?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: He has his own job to do.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: What, like, staring?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Yes, just staring.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: ...Ahem.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Is there... something I can help with?

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Let me think...

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Do you know how to work a planting machine?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: I didn't think so. You don't deal with farming equipment in your line of work.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: This little cube is a six-phase monitor. Use it to place pylons at appropriate locations in the fields, and we'll be able to monitor conditions zone by zone. Can you use it?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I've never touched anything like it before...

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Feeding stockbeasts...?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Pfft—

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Well, if you're going to be here for a while, perhaps you could learn how to do farmwork.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: You could start by clearing the weeds.

steps.name: Nongye Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: Is that you, Laoshi? I—

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Good timing, Xiaohe.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: This is...

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: ...a distant cousin of mine from the capital. He came to see Dahuang.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: My student, He Sheng. He'll teach you.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Is this where the positioning device says the stockbeast is?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Yeah! When I blow this whistle, Mianmian will know I'm looking for him and come out.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Positioning device?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: There's one on every stockbeast in Dahuang. They're not very precise, but they give us an idea of their rough location.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Every single one? There must be thousands of stockbeasts in Dahuang.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Well, we've had a lot of stray stockbeasts. The ones that the older students kept for research had a tendency to elope—

spans.text: Well, we've had a lot of stray stockbeasts. The ones that the older students kept for research had a tendency to

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I'm sorry, I'm not familiar with such things.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Why did you join the army if you're a relative of Laoshi's?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: No important reason, really.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Is your family all mandarins?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Why do you ask?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: The way you talk, and the manner you carry yourself in general.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Not a lot of people your age around here like that, except for a few blue-blood families.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I mean no offense.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: I didn't say you offended anyone.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Weird, why isn't he coming out?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Mianmian had a fight with Xiaobiar a few days ago. Is that why he ran away?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Did he get pulled in by a female again?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: But he likes Xiaobiar! They're always together when I take them out to the mud pond.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Not like that, Candlestick!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: C-Candlestick?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: I'll draw a picture of him. Memorize it, and we'll split up to look for him!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Uh... it's, er, a very good drawing...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Are you serious? I, after all the time I spent caring for the stockbeast, can barely tell it's Mianmian.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Four legs and some spots. What's so hard?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Have you ever seen a stockbeast, Candlestick?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Not often...

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: It's okay. You haven't seen stockbeasts, I haven't seen nomadic cities. We've all got things we've never seen before.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Have you never been outside—to other cities?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: No, but I heard about them from Xiaohe.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: The rice that we produce each year is sent outside. They're developing new crops so the people outside can have lots to eat.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: You'll have plenty of chances.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: No rush. I like this place.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Oh yeah, take a whiff of this.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Alcohol?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Rice wine soup, my favorite snack! See where the steam's rising? That's the brewery. We could stop by on our way.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: So there are breweries here.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Part of the harvest is saved for brewing. The oldest batch is more than a hundred years old.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Do you drink?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I did, once, try wine made from maize leaves. It was a gift from a farmer on a mission. It had a very strong taste; almost made me gag.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: He said it would warm us up, but we didn't expect it to be like that. He said they barely had enough to eat and didn't have the luxury of brewing with grain.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: People out there still don't have enough to eat?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The land is vast. There are big differences between regions.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I hear something... over there?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Wow, Candlestick, you sure can jump!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: We'll find Mianmian soon enough!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Our drones can fly higher than that, and we have the positioning device to help us.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: No need to—

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Wait, over there...

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: A fire?!

steps.name: Assistant Minister of Works
steps.text: Three months?

steps.name: Veteran Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: Three months. This project is no small thing, and every segment needs time to ensure there are no problems. Three months is already on the optimistic side.

steps.name: Veteran Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: 'Twelve Pagodas and Five Cities' isn't just a poetic quote. You know how long the... 'prototype' has simmered in the minds of the Tianshis, from generation to generation.

steps.name: Assistant Minister of Works
steps.text: Of course. The first step is always the hardest.

steps.name: Assistant Minister of Works
steps.text: Though I am but a humble paper-pusher, I've had the honor to study at the Tianshi Bureaus myself. My command of the Arts is a far cry from the masters in the room, of course, but I'm hardly content with sitting behind a desk and drinking tea while staring at my Tianshi apparatus.

steps.name: Assistant Minister of Works
steps.text: Three months. That was how long it took us up in the north, in heavy wind and snow.

steps.name: Assistant Minister of Works
steps.text: Think carefully and give me an answer. How long will it take to finish the assembly of the last two plates of Dahuang's core section?

steps.name: Veteran Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: Maybe a little more than a month, given enough energy and supplies...

steps.name: Assistant Minister of Works
steps.text: There's no need to worry about energy. I have already given instructions for the supplies. Your only concern is the project's progress.

steps.name: Assistant Minister of Works
steps.text: At such a distance, simply transporting supplies is a massive undertaking. Every day delayed represents a huge expenditure of money and resources.

steps.name: Assistant Minister of Works
steps.text: There is no place for complacency, for the sake of the people and the hard-earned taxes they pay.

steps.name: Assistant Minister of Works
steps.text: We are in the sixth month of the year now. I sincerely hope you will be reunited with your families by Mid-Autumn.

steps.name: Assistant Minister of Works
steps.text: Sigh.

steps.name: Assistant Minister of Works
steps.text: Sometimes you just have to ruffle the feathers a little. I'm sorry you had to see that.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: Three months, in the north. You were talking about the Danyan project.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: The city was closed due to heavy snow. The imperial court decided to put things on hold until conditions improved, but when the Messenger arrived...

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: ...He found that the Tianshi in command had rammed the frozen Originium layer open with a segment of the city, rescuing tens of thousands of villagers who were trapped by wintry conditions.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: The textbooks still celebrate the story, the event that took you to the position you hold today, Minister Wan. There was no need to be so humble.

steps.name: Assistant Minister of Works
steps.text: You flatter me. I'm simply an engineer who worked his way slowly up the Tianshi ranks. It's not my place to hold my nose in the air.

steps.name: Assistant Minister of Works
steps.text: But bringing this up is what it takes to get a bunch of stressed and overworked Tianshis to listen to me.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: Seems like you're confident that construction of the Twelve Pagodas and Five Cities will progress smoothly.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: Even if I'm confident, everything has been so rushed.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: There can be flaws in the best-laid plans. I will be counting on your backup, in that case, Assistant Minister Ning.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: That's what I'm here for.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: Now, you've only just arrived in Dahuang. I assume you're not familiar with the place yet.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: It may not be as prosperous as the heartland, but it is rich with gifts from the earth. The many delicacies made from local produce are a delight.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: Have you had the chance to try the local Wu Dou Porridge porridge, for example?

spans.text: Have you had the chance to try the local

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: I'm afraid not.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: Dahuang's Wu Dou Zhou is one-of-a-kind. The five beans, Wu Dou, are red, black, mung, soy, and white.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: They complement each other, but it is the local rice that truly makes the Dahuang Wu Dou Porridge stand out.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: The wonderful fragrance and rich flavor of Dahuang rice elevate an ordinary bowl of porridge to the symbol of Dahuang's culinary culture.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: The five beans each have their own flavor, but it is the rice that makes or breaks the dish. Cooking it is, therefore, far more than just dumping the ingredients into a pot and lighting the stove.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: Heat control is the key. The five beans must not be allowed to usurp the rice at center stage, else it becomes just an ordinary bowl of grain porridge.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: You really must try it, when you have the time.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: I will.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: On another note, how is High Minister Ning?

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: Grandfather is getting on in age, but he has been fortunate to avoid major illness.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: Nevertheless, I hope he will be mindful of his health. Perhaps I should bring a little token when I report back to Baizao?

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: The thought will suffice.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: Given Dahuang's ties to the Sui, I expect I will have plenty of dealings with the Sui Regulator and the Ministry of Rites.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: I have long been in awe of High Minister Ning's achievements, but age spares none of us... it would be better for the High Minister to be less involved in particular matters.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: If my presence here in Dahuang is unwelcome, I can certainly submit a letter to the Grand Tutor immediately.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: You misunderstand. I only meant that the Ning family must be delighted you have risen to the post of Assistant Minister at such a young age, and that your grandfather must have taught you well—

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: Assistant Minister Wan.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: If you simply intend to say, 'The young and inexperienced Ning Ciqiu is not fit to work with the legendary Tianshi of Danyan,' you'll hear no argument from me.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: But as long as we're working with one another, if you have something to say, just say it.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: Stop thinking yourself clever by beating around the bush. A truly clever man would be much more amicable than you.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: I will take my leave.

steps.name: Nongye Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: Water, water! Good thing the fire just started and right by the river...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Why did you start a fire by the forest?!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Arson is a serious crime!

steps.name: Nongye Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: I didn't do it on purpose! The fowlbeast that was another student's project ate my project!

steps.name: Nongye Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: All it left was an egg! I'll get my revenge by cooking the egg!

steps.name: Nongye Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: No, not revenge... I'll cook the egg in memory of my lost project! *sob*...

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Enough of that crap! The fire's starting to spread! Stomp it out!

steps.name: Nongye Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: I have a hoe! We can make a control line while the winds are calm!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I'll clear away any vegetation in the back and stop the fire from spreading that way!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: *pant*...

steps.name: Nongye Tianshi Apprentice
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Stray Stockbeast
steps.text: Oink...

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: ...Mianmian?

steps.name: Mianmian
steps.text: Oink!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Found you!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: What are you doing here? (Whisper) Hey, tell me, do you like Xiaobiar or not?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Where did Zuo Le go? He said he was going to clear the vegetation. But I don't see him anywhere.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Did he... lose his way?

steps.name: Mianmian
steps.text: Oink...

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: ...Should we look for him?

steps.name: Mianmian
steps.text: Oink...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Zuo—

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I'm right here. I didn't find... uh... Mianmian, but I did find this pair in a nest.
Zuo Le is carrying two stockbeast foals in his robes. They are so young that they have yet to open their eyes.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: You shouldn't have brought back foals so young.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I shouldn't?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: But I checked the area and the mother was nowhere to be found. They wouldn't have survived for long if left to their own devices.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Isn't it better to bring them back so they could survive under your supervision?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: We're not supervisors, we're friends! We help each other out.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: They give us wool, we give them tasty hay, chase away bugs, and scratch their itches.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: We don't know if they're carrying any diseases, or if they can be domesticated. Plus...

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: But they've got his scent on them. The mother wouldn't have them, even if she came back.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: That's why he shouldn't have touched them.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Well, he already did, so we need to take care of them.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Why do you keep standing up for him? He's clearly in the wrong. He doesn't know anything.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: I'm doing this because he doesn't know anything!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Never mind. I'll go back and ask the teachers what to do with the little guys. Let's hurry, or they might catch a cold.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Oh! You again!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Have you had lunch? There was a fire here, and you don't talk at all. You would've gotten burned, if it wasn't for us!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Keep your distance, Grain Buds! He might swing his axe at you.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: He won't. He calms down when I play my flute.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: He likes to hear me play.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: See? You all say not to come here, but I come all the time when no one's looking. I just can't cross the river.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: He calms down when I play this tune. I've seen him smile.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: I can even lean over to touch his axe. He always keeps his hand clenched around it, but he's...

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Ouch!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Why did you hit me? Now you've made me mad. I'm not bringing you any treats next time!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: That's enough, Grain Buds! Let's go!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The foals...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: ...We'll bring them back.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Next time, think before you act.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: (What am I doing here?)
